description: Where is good to go in a month, as the site's list of places answers it: every place open that month, the most visited first (how often travellers look it up; the weather never moves a place up or down), narrowed by the filters given -- a region, a kind of place, what to do (hiking, the sea, snow), the weather in words, quiet only, and from a departure city how far (close by, 3 to 6 hours' flying, long-haul). Each place comes with its month as its card shows it: the site's label (sweet spot, good or ok), the weather word, the typical daytime high, rainy days, busy or quiet, and how far from the city given; with how many places fit, and the same list on the site with its filters set. A place under travel advice is never listed. For one place's twelve months, use best_months.

activity.description: Optional, any of them: hiking (a month good for walking all day), sea (the beach and sea good or fair) or snow (a ski place whose lifts run that month).

from_city.description: One of TravelCharika's departure cities, by its airport code ("DEL", "LON") or its name ("Delhi", "London", "Bombay"). Optional: each place then says how far it is, and how_far can narrow the list by it.

how_far.description: Optional, with from_city: close (a road of up to four hours, or up to three hours' flying), medium (3 to 6 hours' flying) or far (long-haul).

kind.description: Optional: a kind of place, by name or id ("Beaches", "mountains", "islands"); several separated by commas for any of them.

limit.description: At most this many places, the most visited first.

month.description: A month: 1 to 12, or its name ("December", "dec").

quiet.description: Optional: true for quiet places only, leaving out the ones busy that month.

region.description: Optional: a region, by name or id ("Europe", "south-asia"); several separated by commas for any of them.

weather.description: Optional, any of them: the weather in words, each a band of the month's average daily high -- hot 30 °C or more, warm from 23, mild from 15, cool from 8, cold below 8.

name: where_to_go
title: Where to go
